question: List every agency's id with the name of its parent agency, if it has one.
reply:
```sql
SELECT 
    "agency"."agency_id", 
    "parent_agency"."name" AS "parent_agency_name"
FROM 
    "org"."agency" AS "agency"
LEFT JOIN 
    "org"."agency" AS "parent_agency" 
ON 
    "agency"."parent_agency_id" = "parent_agency"."agency_id";
```
